title: Zesty Grilled Venezuelan Baked Beans Bowl
description: A savory Venezuelan dish featuring baked beans and grilled ingredients, served in a dolsot stone bowl, perfect for a hangover cure. This ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly meal is sure to satisfy your cravings.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat and cook the chorizo slices for 2-3 minutes per side, until browned and crispy.
In a large bowl, mix together the baked beans, diced onion, minced garlic, and chopped cilantro.
Add the cooked chorizo slices on top of the bean mixture and stir gently.
Grill the plantain slices for 2-3 minutes per side, until caramelized and slightly charred.
Add the grilled plantain slices on top of the bean and chorizo mixture.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the top of the mixture and stir gently.
Add the diced tomatoes to the mixture and stir gently.
Transfer the mixture to a preheated dolsot stone bowl and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional chopped cilantro and shredded cheese, if desired.
